ValidationRule.description: Residential Broker Manager, Enablement Manager and Broker Profile Admin users are not allowed to edit the Broker Name after the record is inserted.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, NOT(ISNEW()), RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Broker', OR( $UserRole.DeveloperName = 'Residential_Broker_Manager', $UserRole.DeveloperName = 'Enablement_Manager', $UserRole.DeveloperName = 'Broker_Profile_Admin'), OR( ISCHANGED(Salutation), ISCHANGED(FirstName), ISCHANGED(LastName), ISCHANGED(MiddleName), ISCHANGED(Suffix) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The broker name cannot be updated.
